copyStrategy: One quiet Bahasa Melayu line per state, set in restrained display type with the app's electric-blue accent; verbatim product copy where it appears (omnibar placeholder, statuses, metric labels). Per-line kinetic entrances that settle and hold — never busy.
emotionalArc: calm -> relief -> ease -> trust -> control -> confidence
narrativeArc: A single electric-blue accent dot states the promise on pure black, becomes the cursor that types a plain-Malay command, travels down a snapped document as its rows register themselves, carries onto a customer's WhatsApp reply where a payment is resolved, lifts that amount into the headline figure of a calm dashboard, then rises to rest beside the MyBola wordmark.
visualThesis: Pure-black MyBola field is the persistent world; one electric-blue accent (#0091FF) is the AI presence and the eye's through-line. Flat surfaces, no shadow, generous negative space and restrained Bahasa Melayu type — the same accent carries the eye from a spoken promise to command, to a self-registering roster, to a customer served, to money resolved, to the wordmark.
